title: India-UK Free Trade Agreement Set for July 15 Rollout; Industry Welcomes Pact
summary: The India-UK Free Trade Agreement (FTA) is scheduled to come into effect on July 15, 2026, sparking significant industry optimism. The pact covers goods, services, and investment, and is expected to boost bilateral trade substantially. It is one of the most comprehensive trade deals India has signed in recent years, covering sectors including pharmaceuticals, textiles, professional services, and digital trade.
exam_angle: India's bilateral trade agreements are a recurring GS Paper 2 (IR) and GS Paper 3 (Economy) topic; aspirants should know key provisions, sectors covered, and strategic significance of the India-UK FTA.
key_facts: India-UK FTA rollout date: July 15, 2026
Covers goods, services, investment, and digital trade
One of India's most comprehensive bilateral trade deals
Sectors benefiting: pharmaceuticals, textiles, professional services

title: India Lifts Gas Supply Curbs Imposed During Strait of Hormuz Disruption as LNG Supply Resumes
summary: India lifted emergency gas supply restrictions that were imposed during a period of disruption to shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. The government confirmed that 15 India-bound ships carrying urea, DAP (diammonium phosphate), and sulphur had successfully crossed the Hormuz Strait. The Hormuz Strait is critical to India's energy security, as a significant share of India's crude oil and LNG imports transit through it. The lifting of curbs signals normalisation of supply chains.
exam_angle: The Strait of Hormuz is strategically vital for India's energy imports; this event connects to India's energy security, import dependency, and West Asia geopolitics — all frequent exam themes.
key_facts: 15 India-bound ships carrying urea, DAP, sulphur crossed Hormuz
India lifted gas supply curbs imposed during Hormuz disruption
LNG and fertiliser supply chains now normalised
Strait of Hormuz: critical chokepoint for India's oil and gas imports
source: The Quint / The Times of India

title: India and Russia Set $50 Billion Bilateral Investment Target by 2030
summary: India and Russia have agreed to set a bilateral investment target of $50 billion by 2030, deepening economic engagement between the two countries. This comes amid continued strategic partnership even as Russia faces Western sanctions over the Ukraine conflict. The investment push covers sectors such as energy, defence, fertilisers, and infrastructure. India-Russia trade has surged in recent years, particularly in crude oil imports.
exam_angle: India-Russia economic ties, especially amid Western sanctions and India's strategic autonomy doctrine, are highly relevant for GS Paper 2 (IR) and GS Paper 3 (Economy).
key_facts: India-Russia bilateral investment target: $50 billion by 2030
Sectors: energy, defence, fertilisers, infrastructure
India-Russia trade has expanded significantly due to crude oil imports post-2022
Russia remains a key defence supplier and strategic partner for India

title: EAM Jaishankar on 4-Nation Diplomatic Tour; Meets Qatar PM on Energy and West Asia
summary: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar undertook a 4-nation diplomatic tour, which included a meeting with the Prime Minister of Qatar to review bilateral energy ties, trade relations, and the situation in West Asia. Qatar is one of India's largest suppliers of LNG and is home to a large Indian diaspora. The visit comes amid heightened tensions in the region following the death of Iranian Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei.
exam_angle: India's West Asia diplomacy, energy security (LNG from Qatar), and diaspora engagement are key GS Paper 2 (IR) topics; EAM Jaishankar's tours frequently appear in current affairs.
key_facts: EAM Jaishankar undertook a 4-nation diplomatic tour
Met Qatar PM to review energy, trade, and West Asia situation
Qatar is a major LNG supplier to India
Visit coincides with regional tensions post-Khamenei death

title: Netanyahu Cites India's Support After JD Vance Calls US 'Only Ally' of Israel
summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu pushed back against US Vice President JD Vance's claim that the US was Israel's 'only ally,' explicitly citing India and its 1.4 billion people as friends of Israel. This public statement highlights the growing perception of India-Israel strategic closeness even as India has maintained a formal stance supporting the two-state solution. The remark drew significant attention to the nature of India's foreign policy balancing act.
exam_angle: India-Israel relations, India's West Asia policy, and India's strategic autonomy (maintaining ties with both Israel and Arab/Palestinian sides) are key GS Paper 2 (IR) themes.
key_facts: Netanyahu cited India ('1.4 billion Indians') as supporters of Israel
JD Vance had called the US Israel's 'only ally'
India officially supports the two-state solution for Palestine
India-Israel defence and technology ties have deepened since 2017

title: PM Modi's Indonesia Visit to Focus on UPI, Defence, and Digital Public Infrastructure Partnership
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi's upcoming visit to Indonesia is set to focus on expanding UPI (Unified Payments Interface) adoption, defence cooperation, and digital public infrastructure (DPI) partnerships. Indonesia is one of the largest economies in Southeast Asia and an important partner in ASEAN. India has been actively promoting its DPI stack — including UPI, Aadhaar, and DigiLocker — as a global model for digital governance.
exam_angle: India's Act East Policy, UPI's global expansion, and DPI diplomacy are central to GS Paper 2 (IR) and GS Paper 3 (Sci-Tech/Economy); Indonesia is a key ASEAN partner.
key_facts: Modi's Indonesia visit agenda: UPI expansion, defence, Digital Public Infrastructure
Indonesia is a key ASEAN and G20 partner for India
India's DPI stack (UPI, Aadhaar, DigiLocker) being promoted globally
UPI now operational in several countries through bilateral MoUs

title: Trump to Meet Zelensky and Syrian President at NATO Summit in Turkey
summary: US President Donald Trump is scheduled to meet Ukrainian President Zelensky and Syria's new President at the upcoming NATO Summit to be held in Turkey. Trump also held a 'businesslike' phone call with Russian President Putin, offering again to facilitate a ceasefire in Ukraine. The NATO summit in Turkey is significant as it brings together key actors in the ongoing conflicts in both Ukraine and West Asia.
exam_angle: NATO's evolving role, US-Russia-Ukraine conflict dynamics, and Turkey's strategic positioning within NATO are important GS Paper 2 (IR) themes for Prelims and Mains.
key_facts: NATO Summit venue: Turkey
Trump to meet Zelensky and Syrian President at the summit
Trump-Putin call described as 'businesslike'; US offered mediation on Ukraine
Russia claimed it captured Kostiantynivka town; Ukraine disputed the claim

title: Iran Seeks Tighter Control Over Strait of Hormuz Following Khamenei's Death
summary: Following the death of Iranian Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, Iran has signalled intentions to tighten its control over the Strait of Hormuz, a critical global oil and gas chokepoint. The US reportedly pressured countries to reduce participation at Khamenei's funeral, with at least 13 nations withdrawing or reducing their delegations. Khamenei's son Mojtaba, widely seen as a potential successor, notably skipped the funeral. The post-Khamenei succession dynamics could significantly affect regional stability.
exam_angle: The Strait of Hormuz is the world's most critical oil chokepoint; Iran's leadership transition has major implications for India's energy security, West Asia stability, and global oil markets.
key_facts: Ali Khamenei was Iran's Supreme Leader; died recently
Mojtaba Khamenei is considered the likely successor but skipped the funeral
Strait of Hormuz: ~20% of global oil trade passes through it
US pressured at least 13 nations to reduce participation at Khamenei's funeral

title: India's Ethanol Blending (E20) Programme Faces Pushback from Motorists Over Mileage Concerns
summary: India's ethanol blending programme — which mandates E20 fuel (20% ethanol blended with petrol) — is facing public resistance from motorists citing reduced fuel efficiency (mileage loss) and engine compatibility concerns. Oil companies and the auto industry have defended the safety and viability of E20, while the government maintains the programme is essential for energy security and reducing carbon emissions. The E20 target is part of India's National Biofuel Policy 2018.
exam_angle: India's biofuel/ethanol blending programme is directly linked to energy security, agriculture (sugarcane/maize as feedstock), and climate commitments — a cross-cutting GS Paper 3 topic.
key_facts: E20: petrol blended with 20% ethanol; mandated under National Biofuel Policy 2018
India's ethanol blending target: 20% by 2025-26
Concerns: reduced mileage, engine compatibility for older vehicles
Ethanol feedstock: sugarcane, maize, food grain surplus

title: Centre Cracks Down on Instagram Over Child Sexual Abuse Content; Orders Immediate Ad Suspension
summary: The Central Government has issued a stern notice to Instagram, ordering it to immediately stop running advertisements and demanding a response over the platform's failure to curb child sexual abuse material (CSAM) content. The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) is the nodal authority for regulating digital intermediaries in India under the IT Act 2000 and IT (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules 2021. This action reflects increasing government scrutiny of Big Tech platforms.
exam_angle: Digital regulation of social media intermediaries under IT Rules 2021, CSAM as a legal issue, and MeitY's regulatory role are highly relevant for GS Paper 2 (Polity/Governance) and GS Paper 3 (Sci-Tech).
key_facts: Government ordered Instagram to stop ads over CSAM content
Nodal authority: MeitY (Ministry of Electronics and IT)
Governing law: IT Act 2000 + IT (Intermediary Guidelines) Rules 2021
Intermediaries must act on CSAM within 24 hours under IT Rules 2021

title: India's Passport Ranking Slips; Remains Outside Top 100 on Global Passport Index
summary: India's passport ranking has fallen further, remaining outside the top 100 on the latest global passport power index. The Henley Passport Index ranks passports by the number of visa-free or visa-on-arrival destinations accessible. India's passport provides access to a limited number of countries without prior visa, reflecting the relatively restricted global mobility of Indian passport holders compared to top-ranked nations.
exam_angle: Passport indices and India's global standing on such indices are frequently tested in Prelims; connects to bilateral visa agreements, diplomatic relations, and soft power.
key_facts: India's passport ranking: outside top 100 (Henley Passport Index 2026)
Henley Passport Index ranks by number of visa-free/on-arrival destinations
Top-ranked passports (2026): typically Singapore, Japan, Germany, France
India's passport grants visa-free access to approximately 58-62 countries

title: Army Corners Two Lashkar-e-Taiba Terrorists in J&K's Shopian; Counter-Terror Operation Underway
summary: The Indian Army launched a counter-terrorism operation in the Shopian district of Jammu & Kashmir after surveillance cameras detected two local Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) militants in an orchard. The Army plugged escape routes and cordoned off the area. Operations in Shopian are part of ongoing counter-insurgency efforts in the Kashmir Valley, where LeT remains one of the most active proscribed terrorist organisations.
exam_angle: Counter-terror operations in J&K, Lashkar-e-Taiba's designation as a terrorist organisation, and India's security architecture in J&K are key defence and internal security topics for GS Paper 3.
key_facts: Location: Shopian district, Jammu & Kashmir
Group: Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) — UN-designated terrorist organisation
Army used surveillance cameras to detect militants
LeT is based in Pakistan; banned under UAPA in India

title: Indian Naval Ships Conclude Successful Visit to Singapore, Deepening Maritime Ties
summary: Indian Naval ships concluded a successful port visit to Singapore as part of ongoing efforts to strengthen maritime cooperation in the Indo-Pacific region. India and Singapore have robust defence ties, including regular bilateral naval exercises such as SIMBEX (Singapore-India Maritime Bilateral Exercise). Singapore is a key partner in India's Act East Policy and plays an important role in the strategic Malacca Strait region.
exam_angle: India's maritime diplomacy, Act East Policy, Indo-Pacific strategy, and India-Singapore defence relations are recurring GS Paper 2 (IR) and GS Paper 3 (Defence) themes.
key_facts: Indian Naval ships completed a port visit to Singapore
India-Singapore bilateral naval exercise: SIMBEX (held annually)
Singapore is a key partner in India's Act East Policy
Malacca Strait: strategic chokepoint near Singapore critical for India's trade

title: NFDC-NFAI's 4K Restoration of 'Oka Oorie Katha' Makes World Premiere at 60th Karlovy Vary International Film Festival
summary: The National Film Development Corporation (NFDC) and National Film Archive of India (NFAI) jointly restored the 1977 Telugu classic 'Oka Oorie Katha' (directed by Mrinal Sen) in 4K and premiered it at the 60th Karlovy Vary International Film Festival in the Czech Republic. This is part of India's film heritage preservation initiative. NFAI, under MIB, is responsible for preserving and restoring India's cinematic heritage.
exam_angle: Film heritage conservation by NFDC/NFAI and India's cultural diplomacy through film festivals are relevant for GS Paper 1 (Culture) and GS Paper 2 (Governance/Soft Power).
key_facts: Film: 'Oka Oorie Katha' (1977 Telugu film, dir. Mrinal Sen)
Restored in 4K by NFDC and NFAI jointly
World Premiere: 60th Karlovy Vary International Film Festival, Czech Republic
NFAI (National Film Archive of India) is under Ministry of Information & Broadcasting

title: Meghalaya's South Garo Hills Records Zero Maternal Deaths for Eight Consecutive Months
summary: South Garo Hills district in Meghalaya has achieved zero maternal deaths for eight consecutive months, a remarkable public health milestone for a region that had historically recorded high maternal mortality. This achievement is attributed to improved institutional deliveries, better ANM (Auxiliary Nurse Midwife) coverage, and effective implementation of centrally sponsored schemes such as Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY) and the POSHAN Abhiyaan. Meghalaya's MMR had been one of the higher ones among northeastern states.
exam_angle: Maternal Mortality Rate (MMR) reduction, Janani Suraksha Yojana, and healthcare delivery in northeastern states are key GS Paper 2 (Governance/Social Justice) topics.
key_facts: South Garo Hills, Meghalaya: zero maternal deaths for 8 consecutive months
Key schemes driving this: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY), POSHAN Abhiyaan
India's target MMR: below 70 per lakh live births (SDG target: below 70 by 2030)
India's national MMR has declined significantly over the past decade

title: India Needs Second Home for Asiatic Lions: Conservation Experts
summary: Conservation experts and reports have reiterated the urgency of establishing a second home for the Asiatic lion (Panthera leo persica), currently found exclusively in the Gir National Park and Wildlife Sanctuary in Gujarat. The Supreme Court had earlier directed the central government to relocate some lions to Kuno-Palpur National Park in Madhya Pradesh. The single-population vulnerability makes Asiatic lions susceptible to extinction from disease outbreaks or natural disasters.
exam_angle: Asiatic lion conservation, Project Lion, Gir National Park, the Supreme Court's Kuno-Palpur relocation order, and biodiversity protection connect to GS Paper 3 (Environment) and GS Paper 2 (Polity/Judiciary).
key_facts: Asiatic Lion (Panthera leo persica): found only in Gir, Gujarat — IUCN: Endangered
Supreme Court directed relocation of some lions to Kuno-Palpur NP, Madhya Pradesh
Current Asiatic lion population: approximately 674 (2020 census)
Project Lion launched in 2020 to protect and increase lion population

title: India's Top IT Firms Face Muted Q1 Results as AI Spending Fails to Translate into Revenue Growth
summary: A report projects that India's top IT companies — including TCS, Infosys, Wipro, and HCL Technologies — are set for subdued Q1 FY27 results despite heavy AI-related spending by global clients. The disconnect between AI investment and actual IT services revenue growth reflects a transition period where AI tools are being implemented but have not yet generated large-scale outsourcing contracts. TCS Q1 results are among the key events watched in the week ahead.
exam_angle: India's IT sector performance, the impact of AI on outsourcing, and India's services exports are relevant for GS Paper 3 (Economy); IT sector is a major contributor to India's GDP and foreign exchange earnings.
key_facts: India's IT sector: contributes ~7.5% of GDP and ~50% of service exports
Top IT firms: TCS, Infosys, Wipro, HCL Technologies, Tech Mahindra
Muted Q1 FY27 growth attributed to slower discretionary spending globally
AI adoption is disrupting traditional IT outsourcing models

title: Drone Delivery Ecosystem Expands in India Amid Regulatory Push for Last-Mile Solutions
summary: India's drone delivery sector is witnessing rapid expansion, with multiple startups and logistics companies testing drone-based last-mile delivery in healthcare (medicines, vaccines), e-commerce, and agriculture. The Drone Rules 2021 and the PLI scheme for drones have provided regulatory clarity and financial incentives. The government's 'Drone Shakti' initiative under the Union Budget 2022-23 aims to make India a global drone hub.
exam_angle: Drone policy (Drone Rules 2021, PLI for drones, Drone Shakti), DGCA's regulatory role, and drone applications in healthcare and logistics are frequently tested in GS Paper 3 (Sci-Tech).
key_facts: Drone Rules 2021 provide regulatory framework for civilian drone operations in India
PLI Scheme for Drones: approved with Rs 120 crore outlay
'Drone Shakti' initiative announced in Union Budget 2022-23
DGCA is the nodal authority for drone regulation in India
